Notes: This column indicates the unique identifier of the student who contacted another individual. These students interacted with the people listed in column V2.
This column indicates the unique identifier of all individuals listed as having been contacted by students. These individuals received a tie from a student in column V1.

This column contains data on the frequency of interaction between students and their contacts listed in "V2." Students were given the options "1-2 times", "3-4 times", "5-6 times" and 6+ times." The options 5-6 times" and "6+ times" were combined. These were recoded as 1 (1-2 times), 2 (3-4 times), and 3 (5+ times).
